about_short_description.short_description: Lithic is a financial technology startup that provides virtual cards and a card issuing platform for businesses and consumers.

product.name: Card Issuing Platform
product.description: A platform that enables businesses to programmatically issue virtual, physical, and tokenized payment cards through APIs.

product.name: Virtual Card Issuance
product.description: API-driven issuance of transaction-ready virtual cards with customizable spend controls for B2C and B2B use cases.

product.name: Physical Card Issuance
product.description: Programmatic issuance and shipping of customized or templated physical payment cards through API integration.

product.name: Tokenized & Digital Wallet Cards
product.description: Provision and manage payment cards for use in Apple, Google, and Samsung digital wallets with centralized token management.

product.name: ACH & Money Movement
product.description: Initiate same-day and next-day ACH payments using routable virtual bank accounts for fund transfers and disbursements.

product.name: Authorization Decisioning
product.description: Customizable real-time transaction authorization logic using detailed transaction data to accept or decline payments.
